news.title:
Nirmal Bang upgrades Sundaram Finance to Buy with TP of Rs 4,900; Bajaj Finance & Shriram Finance are top NBFC picks.
NBFCs showed robust Q4 growth with 27% YoY PPOP surge; asset quality improved for six of seven firms tracked.

Rate-sensitive stocks traded mixed post-RBI policy; NBFCs gained up to 4%. Key indices like Nifty Bank fell 0.54%.
Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance rose 4%, while SBI, HDFC Bank fell 1%. Real estate stocks gained 1-2%.
High number of new directors
news.body: There are 6 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Additional Non-Executive Non-Independent Director Morihiko Fuji was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company’s lack of board continuity is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Final dividend of ₹6.00 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹6.00. Ex-date: 3rd July 2026 Payment date: 9th August 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.1%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.7%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (20% earnings payout ratio) but the company has no free cash flows available, indicating it may be using cash reserves or debt to pay the dividend. The dividend has increased by an average of 16% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 50% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹53.29 (vs ₹50.07 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹53.29 (up from ₹50.07 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹207.1b (up 16% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹100.2b (up 6.5% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 48% (down from 53% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 26% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 18% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 56% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 25% This is considered a minor risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). While dilution might not always result in lower EPS (like if the company is using the capital to fund an EPS accretive acquisition) in a lot cases it does, along with lower dividends per share and less voting power at shareholde

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹1,028, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 19x. Average forward P/E is 15x in the Consumer Finance industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 319% over the past three years. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹442 per share.

news.title: Shriram Finance Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 396.179828781 billion in funding from MUFG Bank, Ltd.
news.body: Shriram Finance Limited announced a private placement to issue 471,121,055 equity shares at a price of INR 840.93 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of INR 396,179,828,781.15 on December 19, 2025. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors and is subject to the approval of the shareholders, in-principle approvals from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited and approval from the regulatory authorities. The company has called an extra ordinary general meeting on January 14, 2026, to seek shareholder approval for the transaction. The transaction will include participation from MUFG Bank Ltd.
